items.title: Milt Fillius interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 18, 2000
items.q: I think the Hefti stuff is very good.

ctx.x: But if you had to pick out three or four recordings that you would have on that proverbial desert island with you, the only thing that you had to listen to, can you think of a couple of things that for you really personify what the music was about? I know you’ve had so many, I’ve been moving your records around.

“Swingtime in the Rockies,” Benny Goodman. I’d take several Basie tunes. There’s so many of them I can’t think really. I think the Hefti stuff is very good. I’d take Joe Williams’ “Our Love is Here to Stay.” I’d take “Four Brothers,” from Woody Herman. I won a big bet with that one day by the way.
